cards.stem: What did the ratified amendments define in relation to the new government
options: varying the compensation for the Senators
cards.quote: They defined citizens' rights in relation to the newly established government under the Constitution.
cards.hint: Focus on what was defined for citizens

cards.stem: What did opponents say the Constitution as drafted would open the way to
options: number of constituents for each Representative
cards.quote: its opponents repeatedly charged that the Constitution as drafted would open the way to tyranny by the central government
cards.hint: Look for the feared outcome charged by opponents

cards.stem: Which body therefore proposed amendments to the state legislatures
options: First Congress of the United States
British violation before and during the Revolution
Several state conventions in their formal ratification
cards.quote: On September 25, 1789, the First Congress of the United States therefore proposed to the state legislatures 12 amendments to the Constitution
cards.hint: Identify the body that sent proposals to the states

cards.stem: What count is given in the opening sentence for proposals
cards.quote: Although 12 amendments were originally proposed, the 10 that were ratified became the Bill of Rights in 1791.
cards.hint: Check the count in the first sentence

every card has distinct options after normalisation (options-distinct)
no stem contains its own correct answer (stem-no-answer-leak)
exactly one option per card matches the quote (one-correct)
every number in stems, options and hints appears on the cited page or in the same quote (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
